source: elka (chemins, barrière ouverte, ciel d'aube ; 16 images refaites car le bocage dérivait vers théiers et rizières), tonchemindevie (sentier de hêtres, lin, verre d'eau, sections notées 4-5 ; mains en trop interdites), la-voie-du-sensible (saisons), beat-haechler (lin, huile, lac à l'aube, notées 4-5), aquafit.
style: Soft natural documentary photography, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, gentle mist, fine film grain, calm and hopeful, realistic.
interdits: No religious or spiritual symbols (no buddha, no mandala, no incense, no dreamcatcher), no violet or neon light, no therapy session, no face, no extra hands, no power lines, no pylons.
evite: Évite le paysage qui dérive vers l'exotique (rizières au lieu du bocage chez elka) et les symboles spirituels : nommer le paysage par ses traits et exclure ses voisins.

404.consigne: An old weathered wooden field gate standing wide open, a grass path continuing beyond it into soft morning light, mist in the background.

ouverture.consigne: Wide landscape of {sujet} at dawn, low mist lying in the valleys, a narrow grass path in the center leading toward a soft warm sunrise on the horizon, calm sky in the upper third, {lieu} countryside only: no tea plantation, no rice terraces, no high mountains, no tropical vegetation.
ouverture.evite: La dérive vers un paysage asiatique ou de montagne.

section-fond.consigne: Vast pale dawn sky above a low horizon of misty hills, very soft gradient from pale white at the top to warm apricot near the horizon, almost empty, large calm empty area in the center.

scene-metier.consigne: A quiet, clear and tidy room for individual sessions: soft morning light through a linen curtain, {matieres}, a ceramic bowl of water, a folded wool blanket on a low cushion, peaceful and empty.
scene-metier.evite: La séance montrée avec un client.

lieu.consigne: A narrow earthen footpath winding gently through a quiet forest at dawn, golden sunbeams slanting through soft morning mist, dew on the ferns, the path leading toward a bright opening of light in the distance.

texture.consigne: A simple clear glass of water on a light wooden table near a window, morning sunlight passing through the glass and casting bright caustic reflections on the table, a small sprig of green leaves beside it, minimal and fresh.
texture.evite: Les flacons et produits qui ressemblent à ceux du praticien.

portrait-generique.consigne: Seen from behind, a person resting peacefully on a sofa by a large window, wrapped in a soft blanket, only the blanket, a shoulder and softly blurred hair visible, face not visible at all, a cup of tea on a side table.
portrait-generique.evite: Le visage, même au loin (règle tonchemindevie).
